items.t: Dishin' it out: Which Chinese restaurant is the best? Vote for your favorite

items.t: Brazilian police searching for Flávio Bolsonaro after he reportedly failed to surrender passports
items.x: The whereabouts of Brazilian senator Flávio Bolsonaro are unknown after the former presidential candidate failed to surrender his passports to police Tuesday, according to CNN Brasil.

items.t: Microsoft offers a quarter of its global workforce voluntary buyouts as AI spending accelerates
items.x: Microsoft is offering 60,000 employees, or about 27% of its global workforce, voluntary buyouts as the software giant spends heavily on artificial intelligence.

items.t: Recognize them? Deputies seek diners after $5 payment on $161 bill at local restaurant
items.x: St. Lucie County deputies are trying to identify diners who allegedly left Nonna’s Restaurant after paying just $5 toward a $161.13 bill.

items.t: Shooting near Boynton Beach gas station leaves 1 hospitalized
items.x: One person was hospitalized after a Tuesday morning shooting near a gas station along South Congress Ave. in Boynton Beach, police said.

items.t: Russia-Ukraine ceasefire in one city in effect after Melania Trump, Pope Leo appeal to Putin
items.x: A localized ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine around the occupied city of Oleshky that First Lady Melania Trump helped to broker has now gone into effect, officials on both sides said Tuesday.

items.t: Cornell student suspended after 2023 alleged assault was then placed in co-ed dorm, professor says
items.x: A Cornell student disciplined in connection with an alleged 2024 gang rape returned to campus this fall after a suspension and was placed in a co-ed dorm with a roommate who had no idea about his past, according to a professor.

items.t: Looking for a safe car for your teen? These used options start under $10,000

items.t: Florida's U.S. Senate Race: What voters need to know before Election Day
